description: Supabase Auth policy as code (V2-03 03-11a, AUTH-02). One row per setting: the supabase/config.toml path, the Management API field (GET /v1/projects/{ref}/config/auth; mapping as used by Supabase CLI 2.120.0 config push), and the value on each environment. scripts/ci/check-auth-config.mjs checks the local column against config.toml in CI (static); scripts/drift/auth-config-hosted.mjs checks the staging column read-only against the hosted project. Staging/production values are applied by the PO from `node scripts/ci/check-auth-config.mjs --print staging` (R-20; no config push). {{STAGING_ORIGIN}} / {{PRODUCTION_ORIGIN}} are resolved from the environment at check time (PO action E0).

settings.dashboard: (local stack only) Auth service on
settings.source: Supabase CLI local stack

settings.dashboard: Authentication > URL Configuration > Site URL
settings.source: AUTH_REDESIGN §4.1 Site URL / redirect allow-list
settings.deviation_reason: Each environment uses its own origin; local is the dev server.
